subject: Request: Keep demo live while procurement routes PO
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@aurelia-labs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: purchasing <procurement@aurelia-labs.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Trial window — procurement routing PO, asking to keep demo live

Hi Karthik,

Quick update from our side: procurement has the purchase order in review but the legal sign-off queue pushed it back to next week. Weve been demo-ing Redwood Inference internally and the team needs the sandbox running through at least next Thursday to finish evaluation and a short performance sweep.

Is there any way you can keep our trial environment active or provide a small bridge of credits while procurement completes? Without access well lose momentum and some stakeholders (model ops folks) wont be able to reproduce the last round of latency tests.

I attached the PO draft for reference — the approver loop is internal to us and moving but slow. Happy to loop in finance if you need a PO number.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Li
Engineering Manager, Data Platform
Aurelia Labs
Attachment: Aurelia_PO_draft.pdf (pdf, 124 KB)

On Mon, Jul 26, 2027 at 09:16 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Received — thanks for the heads up, Sarah.
>
> Ill check with Finance/CSOps about a short buffer (48–96 hours) or a temporary token top-up so your team can finish the sweep. Can you share the biggest test youre running (model + avg seq length) so we can size it?
>
> -Karthik
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@aurelia-labs.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Trial window — procurement routing PO, asking to keep demo live

Jordan — looping you in. Aurelias PO is in legal review, theyre asking for a short runway while procurement finalizes. Theyre running a latency sweep on a 7B conversational model with avg seq length ~1k tokens.

Suggested options:
- 72-hour token top-up (estimate attached usage).
- 3-day sandbox keepalive (no extra seats, just preserved environment + existing tokens).

Do we need finance sign-off for a 3-day preservation? If not, I can offer the token top-up now and track approval after. Theyre an MQL with clear intent — keeping the demo live should preserve the deal momentum (deal: AURE-2027-Q3-1127).

Jordan, can you advise? Ill hold off communicating a firm number until I hear from you.

-Karthik

> Attachment: demo-usage-report.csv (csv)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial window — procurement routing PO, asking to keep demo live

Thanks for the context. 72 hours seems reasonable; CSOps can approve a credit grant up to $1,200 without a legal/finance PO if we tag it as 'demo preservation' for an active deal. If their usage estimate stays within the CSV numbers, we should be fine.

Action: Karthik, please confirm the token amount (we can translate to dollar cap). Ill flag the grant in CSOps and include an expiration timestamp so its auditable. Also cc finance@redwood if you want them in the loop.

-Jordan

> On Tue, Jul 27, 2027 at 10:02 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Jordan — looping you in...
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@aurelia-labs.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial window — procurement routing PO, asking to keep demo live

Sarah — quick update and good news. Jordan has approved a 72-hour demo preservation grant capped at $1,200 USD. Well push the tokens to your sandbox now and preserve the environment through 11:59 PM PT on Saturday, July 31. After that timestamp the environment will be suspended unless the PO is approved.

Please note: this is a one-off preservation to keep your evaluation running. Weve recorded the deal (AURE-2027-Q3-1127) and will reconcile usage against the PO once the purchase order clears. If they expect to need additional headroom we can discuss multi-week bridging but that requires finance approval.

Next steps for you:
- Confirm receipt when you see the token top-up.
- If youd like I can send a short note to procurement@aurelia-labs.com confirming weve provisioned the bridge and the expiry timestamp.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
